results.content: MONDAY WRITETHRU UPDATE: The global box office is humming with Sony/Marvel Studios‘ Spider-Man: Brand New Day crossing the $1 billion threshold abroad in 12 days of release, the second-fastest to do so after Avengers: Endgame. The Destin Daniel Cretton movie is now the 12th highest-grossing ever at the worldwide box office with $1.67B ($654.3M domestic, $1.013B overseas). Brand New Day is chasing history with more records in store and $2 billion global within its reach. [...] For the most part, the movie was No. 1 everywhere in its 67 markets at 72,800-plus screens — except for Korea, where Universal’s The Odyssey grabbed No. 1 with a take of $14.5M. results.content: The success of Spider-Man: Brand New Day has helped the 2026 summer box office approach a burly final figure in the season’s waning days. As of Sunday, this summer’s titles had collectively combined for an estimated $4.24 billion domestically, according to Rentrak, putting the season 23.6 percent above last year’s tally to that point. The all-time summer mark remains 2013’s $4.75 billion.
